note: Google announced Gemini Dec 6, 2023 and shipped Gemini Pro inside Bard to consumers the same week (Ultra came later).
OpenAI shipped customizable ChatGPT variants — custom GPTs — at DevDay, Nov 6, 2023.
The GPT Store did NOT launch by Dec 15, 2023; it was delayed (board crisis) and launched Jan 10, 2024.
xAI's Grok chatbot was announced Nov 4, 2023 and began rolling out to X Premium+ subscribers in early December 2023.
Anthropic launched the consumer-facing claude.ai with Claude 2 on July 11, 2023.
ChatGPT got voice conversations Sept 25, 2023 (Plus), rolled out to free users Nov 21, 2023.
The official ChatGPT Android app launched July 25, 2023.
Apple shipped no consumer chatbot or LLM assistant in 2023.
OpenAI did not introduce advertising into ChatGPT by December 2023.
Meta launched the Meta AI assistant (plus celebrity AI characters) across WhatsApp/Instagram/Messenger at Connect, Sept 27, 2023 (US beta).
The EU reached final political agreement on the AI Act in trilogue on Dec 8, 2023.
Bard received a major model upgrade beyond PaLM 2 in 2023: it moved to Gemini Pro on Dec 6, 2023.
OpenAI launched no search engine in 2023 (SearchGPT arrived July 2024).
